status: Next dependency analysis only; none of these three records is implemented by this checkpoint.

order.source_contract: Flying pursuit with a circling tendency. Ordinary death produces a delayed tiny bomb. Player contact instead detonates immediately: half-heart player and 40 monster damage, versus one-heart player and 100 monster damage for the delayed bomb. Source base HP 7.
order.implementation: Distinct death causes, real swept player contact, one explosion path per death, source identity for delayed ordnance, explicit neutral/player-versus-enemy damage provenance. Do not reuse an ordinary damaging flyer or instant-explosion placeholder. Preserve bomb damage to other enemies, including segmented armor.
order.routing: 28 positive Mines and 23 positive Ashpit templates; standard Broken Quarry analogue, plus actual Shell offspring. No Flooded Quarry or opening assignment merely because both belong to band 1.
order.unknowns: Native steering/orbit strength, radius, speed, contact explosion radius and delayed fuse are not established. Review exact tiny-bomb XML/animation identity before assigning one. Independent damage scaling for armor versus player HP must be explicit.

order.source_contract: Three invulnerable orbiters owned by the Boom Fly produced by The Horny Boys. Owner death turns them into delayed tiny bombs; player contact can still trigger their immediate explosions.
order.implementation: Must attach to a real owning Boom Fly; three stable slots, no independent spawn, no duplicate owner-death bombs or room-clear rewards. Keep owner lifecycle separate from ordinary health damage.
order.routing: Dedicated Horny Boys dependency; no authored independent ordinary route. Debug registry entry is not reachability.
order.unknowns: Owner identity/champion semantics and source orbit timing still require review.

order.source_contract: Two five-part chains: four body parts and an invulnerable head. Diagonal flight and wall reflection, slight nearby-player steering. Armor loss grounds flesh, slows attached chain, changes middle parts to aimed triples and ends to Fly Bomb production. Detached flesh groups pursue slowly; lone flesh stays stationary. Head dies once it has no body parts.
order.implementation: Extend group lifetime/ordered membership, but supply a separate Shell movement/topology controller. Flight state is per part. Do not copy Tuff explosive resistance, acceleration, all-ground motion or short-fragment reattachment.
order.routing: One positive Ashpit template and Ashpit boss pool; standard Broken Quarry with one or two suppliers. Needs ground-safe routes for detached flesh while head can fly.
order.unknowns: Pinned prose says cannot split, then describes promotion when the three-part side has an armored endpoint; shorter-side armored parts disappear while flesh survives. Implement only after recording explicit head/body cut examples and handling ambiguity. HP 35 applies to body rather than invulnerable head; no sourced Tuff resistance for Shell.

required_checks: Real player-contact versus shot-death explosions, damage recipients and exactly-once ordnance.
Hostile family explosions stripping Tuff/Shell armor without ordinary inventory or item modifiers.
Bomb and child lifetime through room departure, capped queues, owner death, simultaneous blasts.
Shell over-cover flight plus grounded flesh collision and no trapped mandatory segments.
Head/body aggregate completion, suppliers, source stage constraints, existing Peep/Bloat regressions.
Native/WASM Original captures and starting-kit probes on actual generated arenas.
